WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
), shares AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_count,
         1.0 * order_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share
  FROM customer_order_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_count,
         order_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC;
